sql:
SELECT * FROM
  ( SELECT oid AS cfgid, (ts_token_type(cfgparser)).tokid AS tokid
    FROM pg_ts_config ) AS tt
RIGHT JOIN pg_ts_config_map AS m
    ON (tt.cfgid=m.mapcfg AND tt.tokid=m.maptokentype)
WHERE
    tt.cfgid IS NULL OR tt.tokid IS NULL
shape: SELECT * FROM (SELECT oid AS cfgid, (ts_token_type(cfgparser)).tokid AS tokid FROM pg_ts_config) AS tt RIGHT JOIN pg_ts_config_map AS m ON ((tt.cfgid = m.mapcfg) AND (tt.tokid = m.maptokentype)) WHERE (tt.cfgid IS NULL) OR (tt.tokid IS NULL);
